name: validation_id
description: Unique identifier (UUID) for this check result.

name: job_id
description: References job_metadata.job_id.

name: file_name
description: Name of the file validated.

name: target_table
description: Fully-qualified target table.

name: contract_name
description: Data contract applied.

name: contract_version
description: Version of the data contract applied.

name: stage
description: PRE_LOAD or POST_LOAD.

name: check_name
description: data_contract, a custom rule name (e.g. unique_key), recon_row_count, contract_match, file_format.

name: check_type
description: DATA_CONTRACT, CUSTOM_RULE, RECONCILIATION, CONTRACT_MATCH, FILE_FORMAT.

name: validation_result
description: PASS, WARN (only WARNING-severity checks failed) or FAIL (an ERROR-severity check failed; file rejected).

name: severity
description: Severity of the failure: ERROR or WARNING; null when the check passed.

name: summary
description: One-line human-readable outcome, e.g. '2 of 19 contract checks failed: email.REGEX (1 row), ...'.

name: records_evaluated
description: Data rows the check ran against.

name: records_failed
description: Distinct rows failing an ERROR-severity check.

name: records_warned
description: Distinct rows failing a WARNING-severity check.

name: checks_evaluated
description: Number of individual checks rolled into this row (e.g. 19 column/file checks for data_contract).

name: checks_failed
description: Number of individual checks that failed (any severity).

name: failed_checks
description: Failed checks as 'column.RULE' or 'RULE' (e.g. email.REGEX, HEADER_MATCH). Query with UNNEST.

name: details
description: Per-check results. data_contract: {file: {...}, columns: {col: {rule: {...}}}}; failing checks include expected/actual and up to 10 sample failures.

name: check_config
description: Configuration the check enforced (data_contract: contract snapshot incl. column specs; custom rule: its parameters).

name: validated_at
description: Timestamp the check ran.

name: created_at
description: Timestamp this record was created.
